entities.summary: 4 songs in the book of isaiah (42:1-4; 49:1-6; 50:4-7; 52:13-53:12) about a "servant of yhwh" called to lead the nations, horribly abused, and eventually rewarded; interpreted as a metaphor for the jewish nation or for jesus christ By Deutero-Isaiah.
